name: Belonger Status by Marriage (5 Years)

qualifying_event.description: A person married to an Anguillian or Belonger for at least 5 years may apply to the Immigration Department for full Belonger Status.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; proof of 5 years of marriage; original documents with English translations where applicable.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 years of marriage to an Anguillian or Belonger.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of marriage to an Anguillian or Belonger.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate and proof of 5 years' marriage
Original documents with certified English translations where applicable

sources.title: Government of Anguilla -- Anguilla Status (Belonger Status): descent/parentage, marriage (5 years), and residence (15 years) grounds, documents, and fees

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Anguilla's initial build. See ai_belonger_status_descent.json's notes for the full explanation of why leads_to_citizenship is modelled as false here (Belonger Status is Anguilla's own local status, distinct from British Overseas Territories Citizenship, which is acquired separately -- see ai_naturalisation.json). This is the full/permanent status a spouse can reach after 5 years of marriage, distinct from the lesser interim ai_resident_stamp_spouse.json status available to spouses before reaching (or without seeking) full Belonger Status -- prerequisites is left null rather than pointing at ai_resident_stamp_spouse because the source does not state that holding a Resident Stamp first is a legal precondition, only that both exist as spousal pathways. The source's page content did not itemise a full document list for this specific ground beyond passport photographs and translated originals; the marriage-certificate and proof-of-duration items are inferred from the qualifying-event description itself, not a separate documents list, and should be treated as likely-but-not-exhaustively-confirmed.
